en: Krishna said: Son of Pritha, hear how, with your mind attached to me, practising yoga and taking refuge in me, you will know me fully and without doubt.
I will teach you this knowledge together with its practical understanding, completely. Once you know it, nothing more remains to be known here.
Among thousands of people, hardly one strives for perfection. And among those who strive and succeed, hardly one knows me as I truly am.

first: भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च ।
en: Earth, water, fire, air, space, mind, intellect and ego: this is my nature, divided eightfold.
This is my lower nature. But know my other, higher nature, mighty-armed one: the life element, by which this world is held up.
Understand that all beings come from these two. I am the source of the whole world and also its end.
Dhananjaya, there is nothing at all higher than me. All this is strung on me like pearls on a thread.
Son of Kunti, I am the taste in water, the light in the moon and the sun, the syllable Om in all the Vedas, the sound in space, and the manhood in men.

first: पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ ।
en: I am the pure smell in the earth and the brightness in fire. I am the life in all beings and the austerity in those who practise it.

first: बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम् ।
en: Son of Pritha, know me as the eternal seed of all beings. I am the intelligence of the intelligent and the brilliance of the brilliant.
Best of the Bharatas, I am the strength of the strong, free from desire and craving. In beings I am the desire that is not against dharma.

first: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये ।
en: Know that all states of being, whether of goodness, passion or darkness, come from me alone. But I am not in them; they are in me.
This whole world, confused by these states made of the three qualities, does not know me, who am beyond them and unchanging.

first: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया ।
en: This divine power of mine, made of the qualities, is hard to cross. But those who come to me alone cross over it.

first: न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः ।
en: Evil-doers, the foolish, and the lowest of people do not come to me. Their knowledge is taken away by illusion, and they follow a demonic nature.
Arjuna, four kinds of good people worship me: the suffering, the seeker of knowledge, the seeker of wealth, and the wise, best of the Bharatas.
Of these, the wise one, always steady and devoted to me alone, is the best. I am very dear to the wise, and the wise are dear to me.

first: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् ।
en: All of these are noble, but I consider the wise one to be my very self. With a steady mind, the wise one rests in me alone as the highest goal.
At the end of many births, the wise person comes to me, knowing "Vasudeva is everything." Such a great soul is very rare.
Those whose knowledge is taken away by this or that desire turn to other gods, following this or that rule, led by their own nature.

first: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति ।
en: Whatever form a devotee wishes to worship with faith, I make that devotee's faith firm in that very form.
Joined with that faith, he worships that form and gets his wishes from it. But it is I alone who give them.
But the result gained by these people of small understanding has an end. Worshippers of the gods go to the gods; my devotees come to me.
The unwise think of me, the unmanifest, as having become manifest. They do not know my higher nature, which is unchanging and supreme.
Covered by my power of illusion, I am not shown to all. This confused world does not know me, the unborn and unchanging.
Arjuna, I know the beings of the past, the present and the future. But no one knows me.
Bharata, all beings fall into confusion at birth through the pairs of opposites that arise from liking and disliking, destroyer of foes.
But people of good deeds, whose sin has come to an end, are freed from the confusion of the opposites and worship me, firm in their vows.
Those who take refuge in me and strive for freedom from old age and death know Brahman fully, know the self, and know all about action.

first: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः ।
en: Those who know me as the one behind beings, behind the gods and behind sacrifice, with steady minds, know me even at the hour of death.
